alpha_combo.mechanism: persistent directional state can continue after a confirmed range break when trend alignment and reclaim agree
alpha_combo.payer_constraint: late or contra-trend liquidity providers and participants forced to reprice after directional range expansion
alpha_combo.observable_entry_event: closed bar with aligned EMA trend, range breakout, reclaim and bounded RSI
alpha_combo.regime: directional expansion; no-trade when volatility is outside bounds or price is overextended from fast EMA
alpha_combo.exit: 2.10R target plus 36-bar time-stop; no policy-owned partial/trailing/runner
alpha_combo.turnover_cost: one entry per transition, duplicate forbidden, verified round-trip cost required, gross move/cost >=1.25
failure_modes: feature redundancy masquerading as independent evidence
alpha_combo.falsification: planted edge must pass while direction-flip/time-placebo/delayed-entry controls remain structurally separable and evaluator intent parity is 100%

ema_ribbon_scalp.mechanism: short-horizon directional continuation after ordered EMA ribbon plus reclaim and sufficient body impulse
ema_ribbon_scalp.payer_constraint: participants reacting after an already established short-term trend and pullback resolution
ema_ribbon_scalp.observable_entry_event: closed bar preserving EMA 8/21/55 order, reclaiming previous close by 0.10 ATR, body >=0.55 ATR
ema_ribbon_scalp.regime: short-term trend; no-trade outside ATR bounds or beyond 1.10 ATR chase distance
ema_ribbon_scalp.exit: 1.65R target plus 36-bar time-stop; no adverse add, partial or pyramiding
ema_ribbon_scalp.turnover_cost: duplicate transition forbidden, verified round-trip cost mandatory, gross move/cost >=1.25
ema_ribbon_scalp.falsification: if frozen planted ribbon impulse cannot create a cost-feasible immutable intent or parity differs from accounting adapter, architecture fails structurally

mfi_rsi_div.mechanism: failed price swing with improving/weakening price and money-flow oscillators can mark exhaustion and reversal
mfi_rsi_div.payer_constraint: late breakout participants trapped after a failed extreme while flow no longer confirms price
mfi_rsi_div.observable_entry_event: closed-bar failed swing plus RSI/MFI threshold and joint directional improvement/weakening
mfi_rsi_div.regime: bounded-volatility reversal; no trade without valid volume or oscillator agreement
mfi_rsi_div.exit: 2.20R target plus 36-bar time-stop; no adverse averaging
mfi_rsi_div.turnover_cost: one transition entry, verified cost mandatory, gross move/cost >=1.25
mfi_rsi_div.falsification: failed-swing planted edge must create deterministic intent; missing/invalid volume or stale/duplicate bars must fail closed

obv_trend.mechanism: price breakout accompanied by signed cumulative volume pressure is more credible than price-only expansion
obv_trend.payer_constraint: passive liquidity and contra-trend inventory must adjust when price and participation pressure align
obv_trend.observable_entry_event: closed-bar EMA trend and breakout with same-sign OBV slope, price move and relative volume >=1.12
obv_trend.regime: volume-confirmed directional expansion; no trade without valid volume or ATR bounds
obv_trend.exit: 2.10R target plus 36-bar time-stop; no scale-in/retest add
obv_trend.turnover_cost: one transition entry, duplicate forbidden, verified cost required, gross move/cost >=1.25
obv_trend.falsification: OBV-confirmed planted breakout must pass deterministic intent/parity while stale, duplicate and missing cost authority fail closed
